source.title: NIST Special Publication 800-209: Security Guidelines for Storage Infrastructure
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.applicability: Covers storage infrastructure security including data classification, encryption at rest, access controls, retention policies, and deletion verification for network-attached and cloud storage systems. Provides technical implementation patterns applicable to enterprise storage environments.
